content_sections.heading: ICFRE IFB Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the ICFRE IFB Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download ICFRE IFB Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): Master degree in Agriculture Microbiology, Plant Pathology, Agriculture/Microbiology/Life Sciences, National Eligibility Test - CSIR-UGC NET/LS, DBT-BET, ICAR-NET, GATE or equivalent national level examinations. Experience in microbial cultures, handling microbiological equipment and molecular work is desirable. Laboratory Assistant (LA): Bachelor degree in Agriculture, Microbiology or Life Sciences from a recognized university. Experience in microbiology/plant pathology laboratories is desirable.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow and Laboratory Assistant: Maximum age is 28 years. Age relaxations apply: SC/ST/Women/Physically Handicapped get 5 years, and OBC candidates get 3 years.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Walk-in Interview Verification of original documents and certificates

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICFRE IFB Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Institute of Forest Biodiversity (ICFRE IFB), located in Hyderabad, Telangana, for project-based research positions.

faq.question: Q2. What posts are available under this ICFRE IFB notification?
faq.answer: The notification announces openings for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and Laboratory Assistant (LA) positions under the designated project.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in total?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available, with 1 post allocated for Junior Research Fellow and 1 post for Laboratory Assistant.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for ICFRE IFB recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via Walk-in Interview. Eligible candidates do not need to apply online or send postal applications beforehand.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 14 October 2026 at the designated institute venue in Hyderabad.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's degree in Agriculture Microbiology, Plant Pathology, Agriculture/Microbiology/Life Sciences along with a National Eligibility Test qualification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for the Laboratory Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor degree in Agriculture, Microbiology, or Life Sciences from a recognized university to apply for this post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years for both posts, with age relaxations applicable for SC, ST, OBC, Women, and Physically Handicapped categories.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The selected Junior Research Fellow will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month plus 27% HRA as per project guidelines.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official notification details?
faq.answer: You can check the official notification details and download the PDF directly through the official website http://ifb.icfre.org or via the important links provided.
